en.title: Tacoma Narrows Flutter Collapse
en.teaser: When steady wind turns structural damping negative, bridges twist until total collapse.

en.hook: Why did the Tacoma Narrows Bridge tear itself apart in a steady 42 mile per hour breeze?
en.math: Contrary to myth, it was not simple forced resonance, but aeroelastic flutter where wind vortices pump mechanical energy into torsional twisting until net damping turns negative.
en.question: Can we simulate aerodynamic flutter and bridge collapse live in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We model self-excited aerodynamic torque, calculate dynamic cable tension, and trigger structural collapse on Canvas.
en.payoff: Tacoma Narrows aeroelastic flutter simulated live in Kotlin.
